description: This file defines the TaxConfiguration class which manages various tax settings for the application, including tax basis calculation and conditions for tax collection based on geographic differences. It implements JSONAware for serialization purposes.

classes.name: TaxConfiguration
classes.description: Represents configuration settings related to tax calculations and collection rules within the system.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the TaxConfiguration object into a JSON string, including the taxBasisCalculation attribute.

methods.name: setTaxBasisCalculation
methods.description: Sets the tax basis calculation method.

methods.name: getTaxBasisCalculation
methods.description: Retrieves the current tax basis calculation method.

methods.name: setCollectTaxIfDifferentProvinceOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Sets whether to collect tax when the province differs from the store's country.

methods.name: isCollectTaxIfDifferentProvinceOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Checks if tax is collected when the province differs from the store's country.

methods.name: setCollectTaxIfDifferentCountryOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Sets whether to collect tax when the country differs from the store's country.

methods.name: isCollectTaxIfDifferentCountryOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Checks if tax is collected when the country differs from the store's country.
